cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can keep the prize money or fund the team trip. Which matters more?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we do a cheaper trip?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've priced the cheapest. It still needs the whole prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll ask you privately, then. Keep the money or book the trip?
